message: Blackouts can be a surprise adventure for kids, but they can also throw a wrench in our plans as parents! I love having a go-to resource to help us navigate these unexpected moments. It’s like a fun game of ‘how can we make this a cozy family night?’ So, whether it’s gathering flashlights or playing board games, let’s embrace the fun! What’s your favorite way to keep the kiddos entertained during a power outage? 🌟
